name: BLS Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages Data Files
known_limitations: QCEW has publication lag, disclosure restrictions, industry-code changes, preliminary-versus-final vintages, and MSA-presentation changes; county totals do not establish facility hiring.
jurisdiction: United States covered employment and wages
automation_notes: Preserve quarter, preliminary or final status, geography, NAICS code, ownership, establishments, employment, wages, disclosure status, and revision notes.
notes: County and industry employment-and-wage rail covering more than 95 percent of U.S. jobs.
